svg.text: Mechanisms today: the incentive configuration of each regime
Red marks the configuration that concentrates control in the assessed party. Hover a cell for the state before reform.

g.data-tip: Financial statement audit, who pays: assessed party now; before reform: assessed party. Audit committee of independent directors selects since 2002; PCAOB inspects auditors.
